decisions.rationale: macOS extension tokens are path-bound; a replaced program in a writable tree runs no more than the child already can. Same contract as decision.macos-reexec (clarification 2026-11-12: UX and DX first).

Seatbelt cannot count executions; re-executing the program runs nothing the child cannot already run. Recorded as the documented macOS contract of Exec::Never (clarification 2026-11-12: UX and DX first, no opt-in for a small, stated limit).
